failed_jobs.name: Tests / Run VS Code extension E2E tests / VS Code extension E2E (Windows, dynamic-debug-configuration)
failed_jobs.reason: Teardown of the dynamic debug configuration E2E test fails with EBUSY: resource busy or locked when removing a Windows temp workspace directory. This is a known, previously-tracked flaky failure pattern (cause vscode-e2e-windows-teardown-ebusy-rmdir) unrelated to the PR, which only changes NuGet package version references (Directory.Packages.props, eng/Version.Details.xml, eng/Versions.props) and does not touch the VS Code extension or its E2E test infrastructure.
